question: What is the meaning of material safety certifications and labels in relation to health and safety?
description: Material safety certifications and labels provide information on the health and safety aspects of a product, ensuring that users are aware of any potential hazards associated with the materials used in the product. These certifications and labels serve as a guideline for making informed decisions regarding the health and safety implications of using a particular product.
